name: AI Marketing Expert
author: Noor Alam

sections.description:
AI Marketing Expert is a powerful WordPress plugin that leverages cutting-edge artificial intelligence to create compelling SEO meta titles and descriptions for your posts and pages. Using multiple Hugging Face AI models with intelligent content analysis, this plugin generates unique, contextual SEO content that can dramatically improve your search engine rankings and click-through rates.

Important: This plugin connects to Hugging Face’s external AI services to generate content. You will need a free Hugging Face API key, and the plugin will send your keywords and content excerpts to their servers for processing. See the “External services” section below for full details.

Key Features

  • Advanced AI Content Generation: Uses multiple Hugging Face AI models (DialoGPT, GPT-2, DistilGPT-2) for dynamic, unique content creation
  • Smart Content Analysis: Analyzes existing blog content to generate contextually relevant SEO meta data
  • Intelligent Fallback System: Automatically switches to template-based generation if AI models are unavailable
  • Content-Aware Templates: Enhanced templates that adapt based on your existing content and extracted keywords
  • Multiple AI Model Support: Tries multiple models in order of preference for maximum reliability
  • Dynamic Keyword Integration: Intelligently incorporates focus keywords and content-derived keywords
  • Real-time Generation Source Display: Shows whether content was AI-generated or template-based
  • Easy-to-Use Meta Box: Simple interface integrated directly into your post/page editor
  • Character Count Display: Real-time character counting with SEO recommendations
  • Secure API Integration: Your Hugging Face API key is stored securely with proper validation
  • WordPress Standards Compliant: Follows WordPress coding standards and security best practices

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Configure your Hugging Face API key in Settings → AI Marketing Expert
  3. Edit any post or page to see the “AI Marketing Expert – SEO Helper” meta box
  4. Enter your focus keyword
  5. Click “Generate SEO Meta” to create AI-powered, contextual SEO content
  6. The system will:
    • Analyze your existing content for context
    • Try multiple AI models for dynamic generation
    • Fall back to smart templates if needed
    • Show you the generation source
  7. Edit the generated content if needed
  8. Save your post to store the SEO meta data

AI Models Used

The plugin intelligently tries multiple cutting-edge AI models in order of preference:
1. DeepSeek-V3.1-Base – Latest advanced language model for superior content generation
2. OpenAI GPT-OSS-120B – Large-scale model for high-quality, contextual content
3. GPT-2 – Reliable fallback model for consistent generation
4. DistilGPT-2 – Lightweight alternative for basic generation
5. Smart Templates – Content-aware fallback templates with keyword extraction

Pro subscription users get access to the latest and most powerful models for the best content quality.

Content Intelligence

  • Existing Content Analysis: Automatically analyzes your blog post content for context
  • Keyword Extraction: Identifies relevant keywords from your content
  • Contextual Prompts: Creates AI prompts that include your content context
  • Smart Templates: Template fallback system adapts based on content analysis

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Hugging Face API key (free account available at huggingface.co)

Getting Your Hugging Face API Key

  1. Visit Hugging Face and create a free account
  2. Go to your Account Settings → Access Tokens
  3. Create a new token with “Read” permissions
  4. Copy the token and paste it in the plugin settings

External services

This plugin connects to Hugging Face’s external services to provide AI-powered SEO content generation. The plugin makes HTTP requests to Hugging Face APIs to generate meta titles and descriptions for your WordPress content.

Hugging Face Inference API

What the service is and what it is used for:
Hugging Face Inference API is used to generate AI-powered SEO meta titles and descriptions. The service provides access to various language models that analyze your content and keywords to create optimized SEO content.

What data is sent and when:
– Your focus keyword (entered by you in the post editor)
– A portion of your post content (up to 500 characters) for contextual analysis
– Your Hugging Face API key for authentication
– This data is sent only when you manually click the “Generate SEO Meta” button in the post editor
– No data is sent automatically or without your explicit action

Service endpoints used:
– https://api-inference.huggingface.co/models/{model} – For AI content generation
– https://router.huggingface.co/v1/chat/completions – For advanced chat-based AI models
– https://huggingface.co/api/whoami-v2 – For API key validation and connection testing

Service provider: Hugging Face, Inc.
Terms of Service: https://huggingface.co/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://huggingface.co/privacy

Data Privacy and Security

  • Your API key is stored locally in your WordPress database and never shared with third parties
  • Only the content you explicitly choose to process is sent to Hugging Face
  • No personal information, user data, or site analytics are transmitted
  • All communications with Hugging Face services use HTTPS encryption
  • You can disable the plugin at any time to stop all external service communication

User Control

  • The plugin only connects to external services when you manually trigger content generation
  • You must provide your own Hugging Face API key to use the service
  • You can test the API connection before using the service
  • All generated content can be edited or removed before publishing
  • The plugin works with fallback templates if you choose not to use external AI services

Privacy Policy

This plugin transmits data to external services as follows:

Data sent to Hugging Face:
– Focus keywords you enter in the post editor
– Portions of your post content (up to 500 characters) for contextual analysis
– Your Hugging Face API key for service authentication

When data is sent:
– Only when you manually click “Generate SEO Meta” or “Test Connection” buttons
– Never automatically or without your explicit action
– No background data transmission occurs

Data not sent:
– Personal information about you or your users
– Complete post content (only excerpts for context)
– User comments, email addresses, or contact information
– Site analytics or usage statistics
– Any data from your website visitors

Your control:
– You must provide your own API key to enable external services
– You can revoke API access at any time through your Hugging Face account
– Deactivating the plugin stops all external communication
– Generated content is stored locally in your WordPress database

For information about how Hugging Face handles transmitted data, please review their privacy policy at https://huggingface.co/privacy.

Support

For support questions and feature requests, please visit our support forum.

Development

This plugin is actively developed with advanced AI integration. Current features include:

  • Multi-Model AI Support: Automatically tries multiple AI models for best results
  • Content Intelligence: Analyzes existing content for contextual generation
  • Smart Fallback System: Ensures reliable content generation even when AI is unavailable
  • Dynamic Template System: Content-aware templates that adapt to your content

Credits

  • Powered by Hugging Face AI models
  • Built following WordPress coding standards and best practices
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log into your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “AI Marketing Expert”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log into your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to Settings → AI Marketing Expert
  2. Enter your Hugging Face API key
  3. Click “Save Settings”
  4. Test the connection using the “Test Connection” button
sections.faq:
Do I need a Hugging Face account?

Yes, you need a free Hugging Face account to get an API key. You can sign up at huggingface.co.

Is the Hugging Face API free?

Hugging Face offers both free and Pro subscription tiers:

Free Tier:
– Limited access to basic models
– Rate limits and potential model unavailability
– Plugin automatically falls back to intelligent templates

Pro Subscription (Recommended):
– Access to latest models like DeepSeek-V3.1 and GPT-OSS-120B
– Higher rate limits and better reliability
– Consistent AI generation with advanced language models
– Better content quality and contextual understanding

For best results and consistent AI generation, we recommend upgrading to a Hugging Face Pro subscription.

Which AI model does the plugin use?

The plugin uses an intelligent multi-model approach, trying these models in order:
1. Microsoft DialoGPT-medium (for natural, conversational content)
2. GPT-2 (reliable and well-tested)
3. DistilGPT-2 (lightweight alternative)
4. Smart templates (content-aware fallback)

This ensures maximum reliability and unique content generation.

How does content analysis work?

The plugin automatically analyzes your existing blog post content to:
– Extract relevant keywords and themes
– Create contextual AI prompts
– Generate SEO content that matches your content style
– Provide more relevant and targeted meta descriptions

What if AI generation doesn’t work?

If you see “(Template-based)” instead of “(Generated by AI)”:

With Pro Subscription:
– Latest AI models (DeepSeek-V3.1, GPT-OSS-120B) may need 30-60 seconds to load
– Try generating again after a short wait
– Models are more reliable but may have initial loading time

With Free Tier:
– Limited access to advanced models
– Plugin uses intelligent, content-aware templates as fallback
– Templates still provide high-quality, SEO-optimized content

All Users:
– Templates analyze your existing content for context
– Fallback system ensures you always get quality content
– Check your internet connection and API key validity

Can I edit the generated content?

Yes, all generated titles and descriptions are fully editable. You can modify them to better suit your needs.

Where is the meta data stored?

The generated SEO titles and descriptions are stored as WordPress post meta with keys _ai_marketing_expert_seo_title and _ai_marketing_expert_seo_description.

Is my API key secure?

Yes, your API key is stored securely in the WordPress options table and is only used for API requests to Hugging Face.

Does this work with custom post types?

Currently, the plugin works with posts and pages. Support for custom post types may be added in future versions.
